release_notes:
🚀 Market Core Update v1.2.8:
• Multi-Currency Support: Live prices now correctly show Rupees (₹) for Indian stocks and Dollars ($) for US stocks.
• 100% Price Accuracy: Real-time Finnhub data is now fetched instantly for every new alert.
• Smart Tickers: Improved stock symbol mapping for higher reliability.
• Refresh All: Manual refresh now updates the prices of your entire alert history.
